fact: At the World Bank implementation support mission of 27 to 31 January 2025, the Sistema de Informação e Gestão Educativa (SIGE) was not in use in schools: it 'vai ser relançado', the terms of reference for its development were complete, and a tender was being relaunched for the ministry's data network, hosting equipment at INIC and equipment for the first schools, under the IDA and GPE financed PEREQT project (P169222) with a ministry SIGE action plan and an EDUTIC-SIGE team.
title: São Tomé e Príncipe: Projecto de Empoderamento das Raparigas e Educação de Qualidade para Todos (PEREQT, P169222) - Missão de Implementação e Apoio, 27 a 31 de janeiro de 2025 - Ajuda Memória
